fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 90% match makes you a STRONG FIT for this Backend role at Duolingo.

**Strengths:**
- Ran Kotlin and Spring Boot settlement service at 40 million events daily
- B.Sc. Computer Science, University of Waterloo, plus 11 years of backend experience
- Kafka, AWS (EC2, RDS, SQS, S3) and Datadog match the cloud and observability preferences

- No ad serving or ad mediation experience, which this Ads team role centers on
- Your most recent listed role ended February 2023

**Recommendation:** Apply now, and in your cover letter connect your high-volume Kafka event processing at Lumen Payments to ad serving and demand workloads.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Duolingo

Dear Hiring Manager,

Running reliable, scalable backend systems for a very large user base starts with fixing the slow paths before users notice them. At Lumen Payments, I cut the p99 latency of our payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis. That's the kind of systems thinking your Ads team needs for ad serving at Duolingo's scale.

As a Senior Software Engineer, I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka. I owned it from design through production, including on-call duty and the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents. I also led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, working with product stakeholders throughout. My 11 years in Java, Kotlin and Python, my Datadog experience and my AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (2024) map directly to your call for backend fundamentals and observability. After a planned career break to care for a family member, I'm back to full-time engineering and ready to take on complex technical problems.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help the Ads team ship and scale. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Software Engineer II, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Hello,

I've spent 11 years building payment and event-processing services, including a Kotlin and Spring Boot settlement service on Kafka that I designed and ran at Lumen Payments. That is the kind of backend work your Software Engineer II role centres on, from building services to releasing and maintaining them. I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, so I'm comfortable owning priorities and shipping steadily. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I'm available to speak any weekday this month.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
